title: Compare stored capacity with active serving pressure
description: A planning model that separates total weights, active parameter paths, KV cache, and sequence-dependent attention pressure on a single 80 GB worker.

precisions.label: BF16 weights and KV cache
precisions.detail: Baseline planning configuration with broad accelerator support.
precisions.qualityNote: Use a task-specific evaluation baseline; BF16 does not eliminate model or prompt errors.

precisions.label: FP8 weights, BF16 KV cache
precisions.detail: Reduced weight footprint with a higher-precision cache assumption.
precisions.qualityNote: Kernel support and quantization calibration must be validated against the release task.

precisions.label: INT8 weights, BF16 KV cache
precisions.detail: Aggressive weight compression while keeping the cache in BF16.
precisions.qualityNote: INT8 may improve capacity without proportionally shrinking long-context KV memory; test output quality and structured formats.
